relationships.subject: symptomatic apical periodontitis
relationships.evidence_quote: Symptomatic lesions exhibited an approximately 6-fold increase in innervation density (410.6 ± 359.2 vs 63.4 ± 75.7 pg/μg) and significantly higher Nav1.8 (10.3 ± 10.3 vs 2.97 ± 2.5 pg/μg)

relationships.subject: symptomatic apical periodontitis
relationships.evidence_quote: Symptomatic lesions exhibited an approximately 6-fold increase in innervation density (410.6 ± 359.2 vs 63.4 ± 75.7 pg/μg)

key_findings: Symptomatic apical periodontitis lesions show about 6-fold higher innervation density and higher Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 than asymptomatic lesions.
Most fibers in lesions strongly express Nav1.8, indicating nociceptive innervation.
